items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Emmett Berry, George Stevenson, Herbie Hall, Sammy Price, Pops Foster, Fred Moore. A series of recordings made between December 1955, January 1956, and February 1956.

ctx.x: 1955. Emmett Berry was on trumpet, and George Stevenson was on trombone, and Herb Hall was on clarinet. How long were you with Sam Price? It was just for that tour, you were saying.
